sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side propping up the division on just 4 points with a run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford seeking to close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between the third and fifth-placed teams, with both showing strong recent form and Eccleshall looking to extend a five-game winning streak. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, on a three-game winning run) face Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before travelling to Brereton Social for a midweek fixture on Wednesday. Bilston Town, sixth on the table with solid recent form, host Foley Meir on Saturday. Market Drayton Town visit New Mills in a bottom-half encounter, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face struggling Telford Town. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at home on Saturday—Widnes remain rooted to the bottom with just 2 points—and then host Wednesfield Community at home Wednesday evening. Shawbury United, on an alarming six-game losing streak, welcome Barnton to their ground on Saturday. Crewe host Allscott Heath as both sides aim to climb out of the lower reaches of the table.
